Customer.description: The payer; every member is optional (empty once the person's data was deleted).

id.description: The payer's user id (for example in Accounts).

email.description: Kept in lower case; '' for none.

phone.description: International format (+…); spaces, parentheses and dashes are removed. '' for none.

EventPage.description: One page of events, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

Gateway.description: An online gateway: payfast is PayFast South Africa, payfast_pk PayFast Pakistan; generic is your own adapter.

amount.description: Minor units; null: the payer enters it.

minAmount.description: The least a payer may enter (null with a fixed amount).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example USD or EUR.

gateways.description: The gateways it offers (empty: every ready one).

active.description: false: turned off, its page is gone.

LinkPage.description: One page of payment links, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

NewSubscription.description: A new subscription with the gateway's page the payer subscribes on.

plan.description: The gateway's plan or price id.

checkoutUrl.description: Send the payer there to subscribe at the gateway.

status.description: pending: waiting for the payer or the gateway; cancelled: the payer canceled at the gateway (they may try again); voided: you canceled it, nobody can pay it.

refundDue.description: Money arrived after you canceled it: refund it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example USD or EUR.

amountText.description: The amount as a decimal text, for example 10.50.

gateway.description: The gateway or manual payment method picked; null until one is.

kind.description: The kind of the way picked (null until one is).

methodName.description: A manual payment method's name as the payment took it ('' for a gateway).

reference.description: Your reference, for example the order number.

metadata.description: Your own labels: up to 20 names (letters, digits, _ . -) with texts of at most 500 characters.

linkId.description: The payment link it was paid through.

gatewayReference.description: The gateway's session, order or transaction reference.

proof.description: The proof of a manual payment the payer uploaded (GET …/proof gives a link to it).

manual.description: Recorded only: you return the money yourself (gateways without a refund API).

by.description: Who did it (a staff member's name, or Server).

reference.description: The payment's own reference the payer or you gave (proof or confirmation).

note.description: The merchant's note with a confirmation.

checkoutUrl.description: The payer's page for this payment: send them there.

PaymentEventData.description: A payment that is larger than an event may be comes without metadata and history: read the payment for them.

PaymentPage.description: One page of payments, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

type.description: payments.payment.*: data is PaymentEventData; payments.subscription.updated: SubscriptionEventData; payments.settings.changed: SettingsEventData.

delivery.description: Its forwarding to your webhook URLs through Notifications (not_connected: no Notifications token).

Subscription.description: A gateway-managed subscription as Payments mirrors it.

plan.description: The gateway's plan or price id.

SubscriptionPage.description: One page of subscriptions, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

Method.description: A way to pay: a gateway id (stripe, paypal, payfast, payfast_pk, jazzcash, easypaisa, rapid, generic) or the key of one of your manual payment methods (for example bank_transfer).

MethodKind.description: gateway: an online gateway; pay_first: a manual method paid before (for example a bank transfer), which may take a proof; on_delivery: paid when the order is delivered; at_pickup: paid when it is picked up.

ManualMethod.description: One of your manual payment methods as payers see it.

key.description: Stored on payments as their gateway.

details.description: Shown under the method when payers choose how to pay (plain text).

instructions.description: Shown after payers choose it, under the accounts (plain text).

proof.description: Payers may upload a proof (with Storage connected).

ready.description: Payers can pick it: always for on_delivery and at_pickup; for pay_first, when an account has a value for the currency, or instructions are set.

missing.description: What to add before it is offered (empty when ready): account (an account with a value for the currency, or instructions).

accounts.description: The accounts to pay into: of the asked currency, else those for any currency (every account without currency); only the rows with a value.

POST /v1/payments.description: Send the payer to checkoutUrl. Without a gateway the payer picks one on that page. 422 gateway_not_ready when the gateway (or every gateway, without one) is off or not connected for the currency; 422 currency_not_supported. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retried request makes one payment.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example USD or EUR.

gateway.description: Leave it out to let the payer pick.

reference.description: Your reference, for example the order number.

metadata.description: Your own labels: up to 20 names (letters, digits, _ . -) with texts of at most 500 characters.

returnUrl.description: Where the payer comes back to (with ?ss_payment=<id>); on https://<your domain> (or a local address while testing).

cancelUrl.description: Where the payer goes after canceling at the gateway.

status.description: Only payments with this status (another value filters nothing).

q.description: A payment id, a payer email address, a reference, or the start of a reference.

status.description: Only payments with this status (another value filters nothing).

GET /v1/payments/counts.summary: Count the payments by status or gateway
GET /v1/payments/counts.description: by=state counts by status; by=gateway by gateway (none: no gateway picked yet).

status.description: Only payments with this status (another value filters nothing).

q.description: A payment id, a payer email address, a reference, or the start of a reference.

GET /v1/payments/:id.description: A pending payment is asked of its gateway again (at most every 30 seconds) when you read it.

POST /v1/payments/:id/cancel.summary: Cancel a payment nobody should pay any more
POST /v1/payments/:id/cancel.description: For example when its order was canceled or expired: the payment becomes voided and its page closes. A paid payment answers 409 already_paid (with the payment): refund it instead. Canceling it again changes nothing.

reason.description: One line, kept in the history.

POST /v1/payments/:id/verify.summary: Is the payment confirmed for this exact amount?
POST /v1/payments/:id/verify.description: Use it before marking an order paid: verified is true only for a payment confirmed by the gateway (refunded later included) with the same amount and currency, never for one you canceled.

amount.description: The order's amount in minor units.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example USD or EUR.

GET /v1/events.description: Also sent to your webhook URLs through Notifications when its token is pasted.

types.description: Full event types separated by commas (at most 20), for example payments.payment.paid.
Full event types separated by commas (at most 20), for example payments.payment.paid.

GET /v1/events/counts.summary: Count the events by type or delivery

types.description: Full event types separated by commas (at most 20), for example payments.payment.paid.

GET /v1/manual-methods.summary: Your manual payment methods as payers see them
GET /v1/manual-methods.description: Each method's words, whether it is offered and its accounts; with currency, readiness and accounts for that currency (else every account with a value). Kept with GET and PUT /v1/lists/manual_methods.

POST /v1/payments/:id/confirm.summary: Confirm the money of a manual payment arrived
POST /v1/payments/:id/confirm.description: Only a pending payment of a manual payment method (409 conflict otherwise): a transfer, cash on delivery, payment at pickup. One you canceled is confirmed too, and is then to be refunded (refundDue).

reference.description: The payment's own reference (for example the transfer's).

GET /v1/payments/:id/proof.summary: A link to the payer's proof of a manual payment (5 minutes)
GET /v1/payments/:id/proof.description: 404 not_found when the payment has no proof; 503 storage_not_connected without Storage.

POST /v1/payments/:id/refunds.summary: Refund a payment, all or part
POST /v1/payments/:id/refunds.description: Only a paid payment (409 not_refundable). Stripe, PayPal, PayFast (South Africa) and the generic adapter with a refund address refund at the gateway (502 gateway_failed when it refuses); the others are recorded (manual) and you return the money yourself. Send an Idempotency-Key.

amount.description: Minor units, at most what is left; leave it out to refund everything left.

reason.description: Kept with the refund (at most 200 characters are kept).

POST /v1/links.description: Share its url. A fixed amount, or null to let the payer enter one (at least minAmount).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for example USD or EUR.

amount.description: Minor units; null (or none) lets the payer enter it.

minAmount.description: With no amount: the least a payer may enter.

gateways.description: Offer only these (default: every ready one).

returnUrl.description: Where payers go afterwards; on https://<your domain> (or a local address while testing).

PATCH /v1/links/:id.summary: Turn a payment link off or on

active.description: false turns the link off (its page is gone); true turns it on again.

POST /v1/subscriptions.summary: Start a subscription at Stripe or PayPal
POST /v1/subscriptions.description: Create the plan at the gateway first (a recurring Stripe price or a PayPal billing plan); send the payer to checkoutUrl. 422 gateway_not_ready; 502 gateway_failed.

plan.description: The gateway's price or plan id.

returnUrl.description: Where the payer comes back to (with ?ss_subscription=<id>); on https://<your domain>.

cancelUrl.description: On https://<your domain> (or a local address while testing).

status.description: Only subscriptions with this status (another value filters nothing).

POST /v1/subscriptions/:id/cancel.summary: Cancel a subscription at its gateway
POST /v1/subscriptions/:id/cancel.description: 409 conflict when it has already ended; 502 gateway_failed when the gateway refuses.
